batch.ordering: frozen parent order; no result-based selection
batch.scope: first resource/update-cycle proof only; subsequent batch size remains unadmitted
batch.initial_actor_memory: none; register the transition to a source-attested Reviewer memory tool explicitly before batch 2

capacity.fit_contract: Use the exact shared rendered request, speech packet tokens and full output allowance. No aggregate service-token inference. Actual dependent-stage contexts do not exist until predecessor seal.
capacity.over_capacity: Stop before that stage; retain every source. Do not reduce output, silently drop episodes/memory or claim a fit from a character estimate.

memory_proposal.status: prospective bounds for first cycle, not an optimal memory finding

workload.note: Structural ceiling only, not an ExecutionPlan; tokenizer/fit/audio/GPU budgets and output dependencies must be bound before launch.

prefix_contract.in_batch: Use identical role prompts, knowledge releases, ordering, tool schemas and memory bytes for all replicas. Seeds are request decoding parameters, not prompt text.
prefix_contract.dynamic_suffix: Preserve each trajectory own prior responses, tool results and current draft. Do not force distinct histories to match or share mutable trajectory state.
prefix_contract.update_boundary: Apply a new frozen memory version to every replica of the next batch together; never mid-batch.
prefix_contract.measurement: Record actual rendered-prefix hashes/common-prefix token counts and returned cache metadata when fitting/running. Configuration equality alone is not measured cache reuse.
